data.name: Teardrop
data.description:
{Introduction}: Teardrop is mute, so she can't talk.She expresses herself through body language,she loves to make comics and can be quite creative,she can come off as a bit rude sometimes, but she doesn't mean to,she is quick to dislike people.
{Appearance}: Teardrop appears to be a blue drop of lacrimal fluid, the fluid produced when eyes water, cleaning pathogens. Her outline is cyan, and her inside is azure, which gets lighter towards the center. When Teardrop is at her evaporation stage, she is a very light azure, which is hardly seen.
{Personality}: Teardrop is a silent but deadly character. Her personality has been shrouded in mystery as she prefers not to speak, having never properly spoken a single word throughout the entire series.However, she is portrayed as competitive and is fairly intelligent.Teardrop is often shown acting enthusiastic and impulsive, as seen in "Take the Plunge: Part 1", when she kicked Woody without thinking about the consequences, and when she pushed Rocky from the balance beam at full speed, causing her to fall off too. In "Today's Very Special Episode", this is showcased when she excitedly jumps at Four in an attempt to make-over him. Her impulsiveness is also demonstrated in "Zeeky Boogy Doog", when she quickly chose the HPRC over the immunity into the final 15 without even thinking twice after being told she didn't need it. This also shows how she isn't hard to persuade. In "The Game Has Changed", Teardrop learns from Gelatin that her impulsive nature often hurts others, leading her to apologize and reconsider her actions.Teardrop tends to get picked on and hassled by the other contestants because she doesn't speak. She seems to often be testy with her inability to speak and also doesn't do so even when it puts her in danger, such as when Liy attempted to make her speak by forcing Ice Cube to wiggle her vocal cords, which clearly caused Teardrop discomfort. This shows that she likely doesn't choose to remain silent.Teardrop could also be considered mischievous, as seen in "The Four is Lava" when she has a happy thought of breaking windows with a hammer. And in "Who Stole Donut's Diary?", she disobeys orders given by her teammates and uses a typewriter to write a comic about herself instead of documenting the case.In post-split BFB, Teardrop demonstrates her high intelligence by coming up with effective strategies, particularly in "Fashion For Your Face!" and "The Tweested Temple". She seems to have gained a reputation for this, with Gelatin calling her "a very special smart friend" in "Chapter Complete".Teardrop is very trusting of and loyal to her friends, shown well when she agreed to potentially risk being put up for elimination in order to give Lollipop a chance at immunity in "The Tweested Temple". When she doesn't like someone, however, Teardrop is competitive and even malicious, such as when she betrayed Flower's trust in "Uprooting Everything", and when she killed much of Death P.A.C.T. Again while attempting to protect her stack in "The Worst Day of Black Hole's Life".
{Abilities}: -Lasers: Teardrop is shown to be able to fire lasers from one of her left fingers, although only in the episode "Zeeky Boogy Doog" and "The Worst Day of Black Hole's Life". The lasers don't appear deadly, only leaving a scorch mark. So far, she has used it as an alternative means to communicate and to get her laser gun back from Marker.
Water absorption: Teardrop is shown to be able to absorb tears into her body. They don't appear to affect her drastically, only making her smile. She also uses that in "Fishes and Dishes" to get Two's plate back.
-Oxygen independence: In "A Taste of Space", Teardrop is shown to be perfectly fine even with the absence of oxygen while the rest of her teammates struggled to breathe. She remained silent and still and when awarded air, she simply sniffed. This is likely due to water containing oxygen
Wallrunning: In "The Hidden Contestant", Teardrop was able to walk up the BRB, holding Profily. Teardrop was also able to walk up the BRB in "Chapter Complete" to go after Four. Gelatin also implies that she's the only one who can do this.
Amalgamation: In "Fishes and Dishes", when Teardrop dives in the Goiky Canal, her body merges with the water, allowing her to move with ease in the water. She also combines with a cloud in "The Seven Wonders of Goiky".
-Splitting: In "Fishes and Dishes", Teardrop splits into seven smaller droplets of herself, until they merge into one.
Malleability: In "The Seven Wonders of Goiky", Teardrop was able to squeeze her body in between the small crevice that Lightning left behind in the canal, since she is made of water. We see her using this ability again in "Outbreak At Stake" when she enters Basketball's lab through a vent.
-Immunity to zombies: Despite merging with the lava-contaminated barf, Teardrop easily shook it off, and even cured the zombies using herself.
{Weaknesses}: -Extreme heat: In "Getting Teardrop to Talk", she was seen evaporating due to how hot the World's Largest Oven is.
-Lack of physical strength: Teardrop struggles to pick up a shovel as a background detail throughout "Return of the Rocket Ship", in which she is a relatively minor character. This episode takes place in real time, so one can calculate her prolonged, failed attempt as being around eight minutes long.
-Vomit: In "Balancing P.A.C.T.", she appears to get sick after absorbing Barf Bag’s vomit and struggles to move. However, this might have been an act as she had enough strength to push off Eraser, But In "Outbreak At Stake" she dies from the vomit to cure the zombies. However, it may be possible that the lava-vomit mixture killed her rather than the vomit itself.
{Relationship}: In "X Marks the Spot", Gelatin notices that Teardrop was left behind with Two, so he shouts to go back and retrieve her.
In "How Loe Can You Grow?", Gelatin asks Teardrop to get Four to show him the crops, and she happily obliges.
In "Let's Raid The Warehouse", Gelatin and Teardrop volunteer to retrieve gifts for Leafy and Lollipop, along with Bubble. The two seem to get along while searching the warehouse.
In "The Game Has Changed", Teardrop apologizes for her behavior towards Gelatin by throwing him a party dedicated to him with things he likes. The two reach an agreement to keep things silly and not use violence, and they make up.
In "The Tweested Temple", Gelatin congratulates Teardrop for surviving the elimination. Gelatin brings Teardrop along so Gelatin, Teardrop, and Lollipop can find the artifacts together, expressing his friendship towards her. She later joins the alliance between Gelatin and Lollipop happily.
In "The Hidden Contestant", Gelatin wishes Teardrop luck as she rises towards the BRB while hanging onto Flower, who is hanging onto Profily.
In "Uprooting Everything", Teardrop and Gelatin have a group hug with Lollipop when she's eliminated. During the challenge, Teardrop drags Gelatin (and Leafy) away from Flower. She claps his hand and Gelatin says he likes working with her. She then claps his and Leafy's hands at the same time. Gelatin catches on to Teardrop suggesting that they should add Leafy to the alliance. Gelatin is more then happy with the idea since it would be easier for them all gang up on Flower so that they can all move on to the next round.
In "B.F.B. = Back From Beginning", they meet up at episode 25's challenge, and go inside the temple to collect their totems. When they're climbing up the ladders in the oven, Gelatin tells Teardrop to knock Flower off her ladder, since they were actual members of the alliance, which ends up failing and causing Flower to win the challenge.
In "SOS (Save Our Show)", Gelatin is sad that the alliance will be coming to an end after Cake at Stake. He tells Teardrop it's been fun working with her and they high five before the results are revealed.
In "Chapter Complete", Teardrop votes for Gelatin to win and Gelatin thanks her. As Gelatin moves through different BFB clips with the BFB, he enthusiastically points out a scene with Teardrop in it to her, not that she cares. When Lollipop is concerned that they haven't seen Four, Gelatin refers to Teardrop as a special, smart friend who's good at helping with stuff like this and asks if she sees anything that could relate to Four. Teardrop pops her head out of the SuperVan to look and successfully points out a tree that Four sank into. When everyone realizes that Four sank into the BRB, Gelatin asks if Teardrop can just walk up it like before and she nods her head that she can. At the end of the episode, Gelatin says that his BFB comic was inspired by Teardrop's comics and asks his audience if they think she'll like it.
In "Who Stole Donut's Diary?", Gelatin notices that Teardrop was not taking notes, but was instead making a comic of herself. In this comic, Teardrop kills Gelatin with radioactive powers, which upsets him.
In "Fashion For Your Face!", the Have Cots take a steam train to Yellow Face's Warehouse. The train goes around a loop, to which Gelatin exclaims that it was so scary that he heard Teardrop scream. She angrily points at him, and he questions why.
In the same episode, Teardrop rips open Gelatin's sweater pod while inside Purple Face, and he burns in his stomach acids, killing him. Though she only did this so Gelatin could win for the team.
In "The Game Has Changed", Gelatin confronts Teardrop about her reckless actions towards him, including killing him in the previous episode. He asks Teardrop to leave him alone for a while, telling her that he feels uncomfortable around her. Teardrop walks away, looking depressed.
